verdict.stance: Neutral / Sovereign-Owned Dominant Azerbaijani Bank (BB Stable)
verdict.summary: Azerbaijan's largest bank (88.5% Ministry of Finance) surged to AZN 15.30bn assets and AZN 250.6m H126 net profit (+61.2% YoY), backed by AZN 2.23bn equity and 75% LDR. Watchpoints are rapid loan expansion (+14.3% in H1), Uzbekistan entry (ABB Davr Bank), and potential $300–500m debut Eurobond supply.

positives: 88.5% owned by Ministry of Finance of Azerbaijan; dominant systemic franchise (BB Fitch).
Surging profitability: H126 net profit AZN 250.6m (+61.2% YoY) after AZN 404.5m in FY25.
Ample funding liquidity (AZN 9.26bn deposits vs AZN 6.96bn net loans = 75% LDR) and AZN 2.23bn equity.
negatives: Rapid loan expansion and cross-border execution risk in Uzbekistan (ABB Davr Bank).
Hydrocarbon-driven Azerbaijani macro sensitivity and potential USD Eurobond supply.
